title: fix: bump @babel/runtime to v7.26.10, addressing CVE-2025-27789
body:
**Summary**

Bumped @babel/runtime to v7.26.10, addressing CVE-2025-27789

| Vulnerability ID | Description                                                                                                       | Severity | CVSS Score | Transitive Dependency          | Remediation |
|------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|------------|-------------------------------|-------------|
| CVE-2025-27789   | Babel has inefficient RegExp complexity in generated code with .replace when transpiling named capturing groups   | Medium | 6.2/10 | babel/runtime@7.25.6, babel/helpers@7.25.6 | Upgrade to >=7.26.10, or 8.0.0-alpha.17

fixes #6664
